homepage.heroHeadline: Equipping Healthcare Professionals for Kingdom Engagement
homepage.heroIntro: We are a global fellowship of Christ-followers cultivating Communities of Grace in healthcare by accompanying individuals and communities to develop a Kingdom perspective that shapes life, vocation, and service. In a rapidly changing global context, Companions of Grace seek to envision, empower, and engage healthcare professionals and communities in creative mission engagement, cultivating thriving Kingdom communities.

story.heroSubtitle: A fellowship born from prayer, friendship, and Kingdom vision
story.intro: What began as God knitting hearts together among healthcare leaders has become a global movement. COGI exists to ignite Communities of Grace — catalytic healthcare professionals who lift spiritual and practical hope in their nations.

milestones.title: A pathway opened
milestones.description: A medical mission journey to Duncan Hospital in Raxaul, Bihar knit together friendships that would later become COGI.

milestones.title: Vision conceived
milestones.description: Weekly prayer and fellowship among leaders in India and the United States clarified the call: healthcare is sacred vocation.

milestones.title: COGI established
milestones.description: Companions of Grace International was formally launched with a founding board, initial partnerships, and the first Kingdom of God seminars.

milestones.title: Global expansion
milestones.description: Programs expanded across Africa, South Asia, and North America through partnerships with churches and mission networks.

milestones.title: Growing fellowship
milestones.description: More than 500 healthcare professionals equipped across 10+ countries as Communities of Grace continue to grow.

beliefs.heroSubtitle: Essential convictions that underlie our mission and purpose
beliefs.intro: These essential beliefs shape how we equip healthcare professionals for Kingdom engagement.

items.title: God
items.content: There is one true God, eternally existing in three persons — Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.

items.title: Jesus Christ
items.content: The Son is the living Word who became flesh through miraculous conception and virgin birth. We affirm His full deity and humanity, sinless life, atoning death, resurrection, and ascension.

items.title: Holy Spirit
items.content: The Spirit brings glory to Christ, convicts of sin, accomplishes saving work in those who repent and believe, transforms lives, and empowers believers for witness and service.

items.title: The Bible
items.content: The Bible is the fully inspired written Word of God in the 66 books of the Old and New Testaments — unique, authoritative, and the standard for faith and life.

items.title: Salvation
items.content: Restoration to God is possible only through Jesus Christ. Salvation is offered by grace and received by repentance and faith — not earned by human effort.

items.title: Church
items.content: The Church is the Body of Christ. Endowed with gifts by the Spirit, it glorifies God, makes disciples, and witnesses His redemptive grace to the world.

items.title: Calling
items.content: Christ sends each believer to share the good news, make disciples, and love God and neighbor. Healthcare is one of the most strategic missional vocations on earth.

board.heroSubtitle: Leaders committed to equipping healthcare professionals for Kingdom engagement

members.name: Dr. Abraham Thomas
members.title: Chairman
members.bio: Abe is a practicing pediatrician in Northern NJ. After completing medical education in India, he migrated to the US with his wife Ruby. Once empty nesters, God opened a pathway to partner with Mathew in discipleship amongst healthcare workers. He is privileged to serve as Chairman of the COGI Board.

members.name: Dr. Mathew George
members.title: CEO
members.bio: Mathew is a dentist by profession who worked at Duncan Hospital, a unit of Emmanuel Hospital Association (EHA). He later served as Missions Secretary of EMFI. God called him to form COGI — a missions effort focused on helping healthcare professionals live lives that advance the Kingdom of God.

members.name: Mr. Charles Faust
members.title: Secretary
members.bio: Chuck is a retired business executive having served in chief operating and chief financial roles for multi-national companies. In 2013, God opened a pathway through a medical mission trip to Duncan Hospital where he met Mathew and formed a close Christian brotherhood that led to COGI.

members.name: Mr. Paul East
members.title: Board Member
members.bio: Paul supports COGI because healthcare professionals have a unique opportunity to come alongside, care, and witness by action and words. Christian healthcare professionals need training and nurturing to grow in faith, be effective in their profession, and bless their families, patients, and communities.

members.name: Dr. Sunil Abraham
members.title: Board Member
members.bio: Dr. Sunil Abraham supports the work of COGI because of its vision to equip and strengthen the disciples of Christ in healthcare. Healthcare workers need encouragement, fellowship, and a fresh vision to perceive their work beyond their job.

members.name: Dr. Manoj Jacob
members.title: Board Member
members.bio: Dr. Manoj Jacob served as General Secretary of the Evangelical Medical Fellowship of India (EMFI) while Mathew was Managing Director of Duncan Hospital. He joined the Board to lend support as the vision gained momentum — impressed by partnerships and geographical engagements formed in the first year.
